name: Lopsided Truncated-Cube Contraction Obstructions
definition: With distinguished coordinate $s=d$, let $\mathcal W_d$ contain every subset of $[d]$ of size at most $d-3$ and every $(d-2)$-subset of $[d-1]$.
parameters: $d\ge4$. It has $2^d-\binom d2-2$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: The coordinate $s$ is the unique direction omitted by every retained maximal $(d-2)$-state.
recognition: The family is the downset whose maximal states are the $(d-2)$-subsets avoiding $s$. Contracting $s$ gives a one-vertex-deleted cube; every other contraction is a lower-layer family plus one co-singleton and has an explicit union-closed translate.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. The member $\mathcal W_4$ is representative 4.1 of the dimension-four computational catalogue.
